notes: The kept 40 cover circRNA biology broadly (biogenesis, translation, miRNA sponging, Cdr1as knockout, innate-immune sensing, cardiac and vascular circRNAs), m6A and the wider epitranscriptome (METTL16, m1A, ac4C, YTHDF2 decay, m6A effects on RNA structure, m6A in stem cells, T cells, melanoma and miRNA processing), miRNA biology (target-affinity biochemistry, circulating and exosomal miRNAs, cross-kingdom miRNA-microbiota effects, a first-in-human miR-34a mimic), lncRNA function (local cis regulation, MALAT1 knockout, HISLA, lncRNA-encoded micropeptides, autism transcriptome) and RNP/RBP biology (stress-granule phase separation, G3BP, C9orf72 dipeptide repeats). Thin spots: almost nothing on piRNA, siRNA/RNAi mechanism, tRNA fragments or RNA decay enzymology, no structural work on Argonaute or the spliceosome, and splicing is represented only indirectly - the shortlist itself was dominated by circRNA, m6A-cancer and exosome papers, and the most-cited RBP and splicing entries were ENCODE-style resources that had to be dropped.
